/.description: Osyrys engineers interactive media: VR/AR games, simulations and real-time 3D experiences for enterprise and entertainment.

/enterprise/.description: Explore Osyrys enterprise projects in VR training, adaptive simulations, shared experiences and generative content pipelines.

/entertainment/.description: Explore games, online worlds and interactive storytelling by Osyrys, from cooperative VR experiences to cultural adventures.

/about/.description: Meet Alexis Salinas Mark: self-taught programmer, architecture graduate and Osyrys founder with nearly 10 years in VR/AR, games and product design, and 80+ projects delivered.

/contact/.description: Contact Osyrys about your next interactive experience. Share your idea, audience, timing and project scope at hello@syry.io.

deferredDescriptions./projects/galactic-gorilla-corps/: Join Galactic Gorilla Corps, an upcoming co-op VR game from Osyrys. Complete squad missions, build your loadout and fight the Arachnids.
deferredDescriptions./projects/cyberblade-battles/: Cyberblade Battles is a solo or co-op VR game from Osyrys featuring procedural raids, loot, bosses, guns and cyberblades.
deferredDescriptions./projects/quantum-hack/: Quantum Hack is a cooperative VR puzzle experience for IE University. Stop a hacker while exploring qubits, superposition and entanglement.
deferredDescriptions./projects/andean-skies/: Andean Skies is a cultural VR experience for Planetarium Cusco exploring Andean astronomy, Inca traditions, seasons and agriculture.
deferredDescriptions./projects/apu/: APU is a mythic voxel mountain adventure from Osyrys. Survive cold, wind and sheer cliffs in a web game built with GPT-5.5 and Codex.
deferredDescriptions./projects/work-at-heights/: Work at Heights is a Meta Quest VR simulation for Mine Class covering PPE, fall-arrest checks, scaffold inspection and safe ascent.
deferredDescriptions./projects/inappropriate-workplace-behavi: A VR avatar embodiment experience for PowerSkillsAI and Virtual Brain that helps participants recognise inappropriate workplace interactions from another perspective.
deferredDescriptions./projects/logistics-training/: Picking and Packing is a VR simulation for Simulogix / PowerSkillsAI covering product scanning, packaging, sealing, labeling and dispatch.
deferredDescriptions./projects/modasa-digital-twin/: Manufacturing Factory is a VR tour of Modasa's plant, exploring generator production, bus manufacturing, service workshops and safety.
deferredDescriptions./projects/cyclone-cleaning/: Cyclone Tower Cleaning is a VR simulation for Pacasmayo covering PPE, equipment isolation, air-cannon lockout, cleaning and blockage response.
deferredDescriptions./projects/warehouse-forklift-safety/: Warehouse Forklift Safety is a VR simulation for Overall covering forklift hazards, equipment authorisation, tool inspections and safe decisions.
deferredDescriptions./projects/raise-boring-experience/: Raise Boring Experience is a VR showroom for Tumi Mining covering SBM 400 SR transport, positioning, pilot drilling and upward reaming.
